scripts.build: npm run build -w @wfh/contracts && npm run build -w @wfh/common && npm run build -w @wfh/identity && npm run build -w @wfh/attendance && npm run build -w @wfh/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wfh/contracts && npm run build -w @wfh/common && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n contracts,common,identity,attendance,web -c cyan,yellow,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @wfh/contracts" "npm run dev -w @wfh/common" "npm run dev -w @wfh/identity" "npm run dev -w @wfh/attendance" "npm run dev -w @wfh/web"
scripts.migrate: npm run migrate -w @wfh/identity && npm run migrate -w @wfh/attendance
scripts.test: npm run build -w @wfh/contracts && npm run build -w @wfh/common && npm run build -w @wfh/attendance && node --import tsx --test tests/unit.test.ts tests/backend.test.ts tests/frontend.test.ts tests/formatting.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
